{"notes": "Visit 2 (2:45). Table: one continuous dark (connected) chain from start, running up-left to a fork at x~20. One branch goes along the top of the body, left and down to x~3.5, then curls to the nose end near (6.5,13). The other branch is the upper tail lobe, to x~27. No pale dominoes, no bottom line, no lower tail lobe, so no closed fish yet. About 4 min used. I still don't know who placed which dominoes, so I'm not crediting anyone for the chain itself.

Priya: Said at 2:15 the line was 7 dominoes from the nose, so she appears to be building the long body line. That fits the long chain, but it's unverified and I can't confirm it's hers. Gave Tom a clear status update, which is good for collaboration. The pad conflict from visit 1 seems resolved, since building is underway. Unclear whether she ever sketched.

Tom: Only talk seen this visit (2:15, 2:30). He is waiting for Priya's line to reach the nose before starting the bottom line, which is sequential. Nothing of his is visible on the table. His bottom line is the main risk to the finish. Communication is good, but his output is unproven. Ask why he isn't pre-building, and check next visit.

Leo: Said his tail is 'queued' and he'll check the join. No pale queued dominoes are visible. The upper tail lobe exists but I can't attribute it. Verify what he has actually built.

Maya: Absent from conversation this visit. Top line exists, but I can't tell whether she built it or Priya did. Ask her.

Next visit: is the bottom line built and joined at the nose? Is the lower tail lobe done? Does it all connect? Hold ratings until I see output."}
